Chapter 825: Chapter 25: Understanding The Void (Happy 61, Please Subscribe)

Chapter 825: Chapter 25: Understanding the Void (Happy 61, Please Subscribe)

“This gift…”

Lin Yuan swept his gaze over the vast space inside the huge rock, his expression slightly solemn.

The gift prepared by the creator of the secret realm was in celebration of the next existence at the Tenth Stage under the Boundless Void.

He paid great attention to this, and naturally, the gift was also very precious; even Lin Yuan was somewhat surprised.

However, in some ways, Lin Yuan could also be considered an existence at the Tenth Stage.

Accepting this gift was only natural.

...

Lin Yuan scrutinized every detail of the space inside the huge rock and finally nodded slightly, saying, “A total of six hundred and seventy-eight.”

Indeed.

The gift prepared by the creator of the secret realm was precisely the Void Creatures.

Moreover, they were Void Creature Monarchs at the peak of the Ninth Stage, all six hundred and seventy-eight of them.

At this moment, they were all neatly sleeping within the vast space of the huge rock.

Void Creatures are not life forms from the Boundless Void, but rather from outside the Boundless Void, between dimensions and dimensional gaps.

Therefore, Void Creatures are also known as gap-life forms.

Killing Void Creatures can enhance one’s spiritual will.

The stronger the Void Creatures killed, the greater the increase in the spirit will index.

Among them, the monarchs of the Void Creatures undoubtedly provide the best improvement to spiritual will.

Lin Yuan still remembered when he killed his first Ninth-Stage Void Creature Monarch.

It directly increased his spirit will index from twelve million points to nearly twenty million points.

A single Void Creature Monarch directly increased nearly eight million points of spiritual will, on top of the base of twelve million points?

Such an increase, even within the Main Universe, was unheard of by Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan even speculated that if his spirit will index wasn’t twelve million points but instead one or two million points.

Would killing that Ninth-Stage perfect Void Creature Monarch have directly soared his spirit will index to twelve or twenty million points?

The higher the spirit will index, the more difficult it is to improve.

From this, one can see how valuable a Ninth-Stage Void Creature Monarch really is.

Unfortunately, Ninth-Stage Void Creature Monarchs are too rare.

Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit had ventured through the Void Secret Realm for hundreds of years and had only encountered that one.

Now, with Lin Yuan’s Fusion of Time and Space insight reaching the Sixth Realm, he can see through the entire Void Secret Realm at a glance, and so far, he has only discovered four Void Creature Monarchs.

Two of them are only at the Eighth Layer, and the other two are at the Ninth Stage.

These four Void Creature Monarchs are all hidden in extremely secretive locations within the Void Secret Realm, locations that even the Perfect Demon True Lords might not discover for tens of billions of years.

But now—

A full six hundred and seventy-eight Void Creature Monarchs, quietly sleeping within the space of the huge rock.

And these six hundred and seventy-eight Void Creature Monarchs, all at the Ninth Stage, and at the peak of the Ninth Stage at that, any one of them is enough to significantly elevate Lin Yuan’s spiritual will over the only one he had ever killed.

“Such a grand gesture…”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but exclaim.

So many Void Creature Monarchs… it’s likely that since the creation of the Void Secret Realm to date, all the existing Void Creature Monarchs combined wouldn’t match this number.

Even the Child of the Void, the controller of the Void Secret Realm, has never seen so many Void Creature Monarchs.

Otherwise, he would not have become the creator of the secret realm, presenting a congratulatory gift to a Tenth Stage existence of later generations.

At least in the creator’s eyes, so many Void Creature Monarchs could have a significant effect on a Tenth-Stage existence.

“That’s right.”

Lin Yuan thought for a moment, his expression pensive.

The original creator of the Void Secret Realm had gathered many gap-life forms from beyond the Boundless Void, and he definitely kept on hand the highest quality batch of those gap-life forms.

And this accounts for the hundreds of Ninth-Stage perfect Void Creatures currently inside the huge rock.

“With my current strength, I can also briefly escape the Boundless Void and touch the gaps between different dimensions to capture those gap-life creatures…”

Lin Yuan touched his chin, thinking to himself.

After reaching the Sixth Realm of Fusion of Time and Space insight, he felt that he could break free from the shackles of the Boundless Void, following the Void Secret Realm to the dimensional gap areas.

“Never mind.”

“It’s too time-consuming.”

Lin Yuan quickly abandoned the idea.

Originally, for the creator of the secret realm to capture so many Void Creatures, it took countless years, far beyond hundreds of billions, with an average of tens of millions of years needed for a single Void Creature Monarch.

Lin Yuan’s current strength, indeed, is somewhat stronger than that of the secret realm’s creator, but not much stronger. To spend tens of millions of years capturing a Void Creature Monarch?

In tens of millions of years, Lin Yuan doesn’t even know to what heights he could evolve.

The creator of the secret realm did so because he had reached a dead end.

But Lin Yuan has no such need.

With that time, even if he allows his spiritual will to grow slowly,

It would be much faster than capturing Void Creature Monarchs.

“So many Ninth-Stage perfect Void Creature Monarchs, I wonder how much they can elevate my spiritual will index…”

Lin Yuan looked at the many Void Creature Monarchs in the space inside the huge rock, his face showing anticipation.

According to Lin Yuan’s original plan, within this Boundless Void, his spiritual will’s upper limit would be around twenty-five million points.

Because the number of Void Creatures is limited, there just aren’t that many for Lin Yuan to kill,

Especially after passing twenty million points, only by killing the monarchs among the Void Creatures could he make some progress.

But now, looking at the many Void Creature Monarchs inside the space of the huge rock, Lin Yuan also has some doubts about his ultimate spiritual will index limit.
